method: Compare 512/1024/2048 triangle candidates using native MASK-texture alpha-tested XY/XZ/YZ union at256px. Material-isolated Meshopt simplifyWithAttributes compares absolute0.25%,0.5%,1%,2%height error, normal weights.02height and UV.1height; compare original-component alternative. Greedy union coverage selects whole components when <=128tri, connected original-index patches otherwise. Triangle budget is hard;75%intersection/reference is a measured target, exceptions are reported. Error bound applies to attribute simplification before component omission, not omitted source surfaces. V77 flowers retain complete native geometry and original BotanicalColor; they are exempt from the grass triangle cap to preserve flower heads and foliage. Surviving positions/normals/UV/colors exact; separate Float32attributes; native source unchanged.
